notices.html: Heat advisory through Saturday evening: heat index near 100 to 102°F is expected Saturday afternoon, easing by evening, with a chance of storms. Sunday looks milder (high near 88°F) but watch for pop-up storms before evening. Plan outdoor picking and festivals for the morning, bring extra water, and keep an indoor backup for Saturday afternoon.

blurbs.terhune: This weekend: blackberries are pick-your-own (picking began Aug 4), along with green beans, peppers and tomatoes. Still no peaches this year, the spring freeze wiped out the stone fruit crop. Store and donuts open 9 to 6, no pets; call 609-924-2310 to confirm the day's picking.
blurbs.leeturkey: This weekend: no confirmed 2026 update found for this small, diversified farm. Early August usually brings blackberries, corn and tomatoes, with peaches a toss-up after the spring freeze hit the region. Call 609-448-0629 to confirm the day's picking and hours before you go.
blurbs.vonthun: This weekend: blackberries should still be going at the Monmouth Junction fields, with apples starting and blueberries wrapped for the season. Note that Von Thun's Sunflower Festival is at their Washington Township location in Warren County, not here, so call 732-329-8656 to confirm what's ready to pick at Monmouth Junction.
blurbs.emerys: This weekend: Emery's main blueberry crop is generally winding down by early August, though sunflowers may be blooming for picking. Call the farm at 609-758-8514 to check what's actually out before you drive over.
blurbs.battleview: This weekend: the spring freeze wiped out cherries, peaches, nectarines and apples this year, so Battleview isn't much of a PYO stop right now. Bakery and store stay open for cider donuts and baked goods; call 732-462-0756 to confirm what's on hand.
blurbs.johnsons: This weekend: blackberries are newly added for 2026, and blueberries are likely in their last days. An Evening Sunflower Stroll runs Aug 6 to 8 (ticketed, golden-hour hours), so it overlaps Saturday but not Sunday. Call the Pick Your Own Hotline 609-654-5894 to confirm what's ready before you go.
